# source-rich-quality-fixture

Owned by: research-framework-tests

## What is this

A knowledge vault scoped to: Curated high-quality sources with comfortable coverage targets for source-quality-pruning regression (FR-011).

Organization: Synthetic fixture

## Structure

- `AGENTS.md` — Layer 1 index for agents (read first)
- `CLAUDE.md` — agent conventions, note schema, quality bar
- `data_vault/` — Layer 2 notes organized by type
- `_templates/` — per-type note templates
- `_pipeline/` — generation artifacts (coverage targets, cycle reports, budget log)
- `scripts/` — vault validation scripts

## Commands

Run against this vault:

```bash
python update_vault.py refresh
python update_vault.py validate
python update_vault.py reindex
python scripts/validate_vault.py .
python scripts/check_template_compliance.py .
python scripts/check_acronym_links.py .
python scripts/vault_metrics.py .
```
